critical_code_review_comments: web_panel/src/pages/admin/LivePartnerMap.jsx partnerPhoto() + DUMMY_AVATAR correctly handles 3 cases: (a) absolute http(s)/data:/blob: URLs returned as-is, (b) relative paths prefixed with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, (c) falsy value → inline SVG placeholder. The onError fallback to DUMMY_AVATAR provides a second safety net.
